note: General guide written by the StudIn owner for orientation only. Exams, eligibility, fees and seat rules change every year: always confirm on the official site of the exam or institute.

tree.s: Class 10 done. Four main roads: stay in school (11th-12th), diploma, ITI, or skill courses.

c.s: Your stream decides which degrees you can enter later.
Needs Maths and/or Biology in Class 11-12.
